goal_checks.finding: Exact logical allocation was measured only after fixed-four-page recovery. Automatic admission failed, and near-full population timed out after 15360 processed tokens with no response.
CPU-canonical Turbo4 host rows were observed only in a bounded 6401-token pressure run; canonical backing at near-full 262144 occupancy was not demonstrated.
Four hot pages bounded allocation and pressure diagnostics, but the automatic byte-ledger admission OOMed and therefore did not safely derive production capacity.
No known cold logical page was correlated through query selection, H2D promotion, physical slot/fence and same-operation attention.
The recovered allocation reported 262144 native MTP rows, 276955000 bytes, GPU placement and Turbo4 K/V. This is allocation evidence, not occupied-context generation evidence.
Bounded selected-all passed 6/6, but lossless full-context residency, cold-page identity and exact full-context parity were not measured.
Only bounded sentinels are valid; the selective series stopped with 8 passes and 11 competing/focus mismatches, and no telemetry-gated full matrix or 262K retrieval result exists.
The second equal-work pressure request aborted during checkpoint save, before cold promotion, churn, restore and slot-reuse correlation.
No target trial completed. The 20K warmup stopped at 3072/19600 tokens, 175K/262K startup failed, and no release-matched control ratio exists.
Correctly not attempted because the base goal was unmet; this optional result does not affect the base verdict.

quality_result.interpretation: Selected-all evidence is encouraging but insufficient for lossless/full-context parity, and selective mismatches cannot be accepted without cold-route evidence.

performance_result.speed_verdict: No ambitious speed claim is supported. Long-context prefill is the first measured bottleneck, but pager cost is not separable from model compute without a completed target/control pair.
performance_result.historical_threshold_policy: 3x/5x CPU-KV and 70% all-GPU comparisons remain annotations, not pass gates.

soak_result.failure: checkpoint-save tensor read out of bounds on the second request

verdict_reason: The base mechanism lacks occupied 262144-token functionality, budget-derived admission, physical cold retrieval, lossless full-context parity, a complete lifecycle soak, and any valid speed/control curve. Allocation-only GPU MTP and bounded sentinels do not offset those missing hard requirements.
